_note: This is a representative example, not a live response. The patient and encounter values would be server-assigned IDs the app uses to scope its FHIR queries. The access_token is an opaque bearer the app passes back in subsequent requests as Authorization: Bearer <token>. The id_token (OpenID Connect) carries identity claims about the launching user (the clinician). The refresh_token can be exchanged at the token endpoint for a new access_token when this one expires.
